outcome: Severe maternal morbidity (SMM) during delivery hospitalization
cohort: Participants were 2,570,808 mothers who had deliveries in Michigan, Oregon, and South Carolina between 2008-2020.
finding: Preterm delivery, especially when medically indicated, is strongly associated with an increased risk of severe maternal morbidity during delivery hospitalization, throughout the postpartum period, and with postpartum readmissions.
gest_age: Preterm births categorized as ≤ 31 weeks, 32-33 weeks, and 34-36 weeks
